issue_context.title: [Feature]: Display test steps in trace snapshots
issue_context.body:
### 🚀 Feature Request

Display in trace snapshots the corresponding test step.

### Example

![image](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/assets/139439933/a2d0794b-781b-4363-a382-63d0f92a909e)


### Motivation

This would improve overall traceability and enable quicker error identification.
comments: Discussed offline: We will add breadcrumbs on the right side above the Trace Viewer.

review_comments: Ideally I'd test that `test.step` nesting works, but it seems like we don't have coverage for that / if I use `test.step` it does not end up as nesting inside the runAndTrace trace-viewer.
